content.content:
# Notely

A small team notes app. Next.js App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind.

## Status

- Users live in `src/lib/users.ts` as an in-memory list.
- `/dashboard` shows the current user and the team.
- There is no sign-in, no billing, and no email yet.

## Develop

```bash
npm run dev
```
---gitignore---
# See https://help.github.com/articles/ignoring-files/ for more about ignoring files.

# dependencies
/node_modules
/.pnp
.pnp.*
.yarn/*
!.yarn/patches
!.yarn/plugins
!.yarn/releases
!.yarn/versions

# testing
/coverage

# next.js
/.next/
/out/

# production
/build

# misc
.DS_Store
*.pem

# debug
npm-debug.log*
yarn-debug.log*
yarn-error.log*
.pnpm-debug.log*

# env files (can opt-in for committing if needed)
.env*

# vercel
.vercel

# typescript
*.tsbuildinfo
next-env.d.ts
